verdict.rationale: Veriff's API is callable end-to-end without any UI (create session, submit media, poll decision, receive webhooks) and test integrations let you trigger decisions programmatically for development without incurring paid usage, which supports scripted/automated testing pipelines. However, there is no explicit CLI, CI-integration guide, or documented automation/agent workflow — actual verification still requires real end-user media/liveness capture, which limits true headless automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CLI tooling, documented automated test pipelines, and headless-agent-oriented workflow examples.
